claim: Under the causal full behavior-rank bound, an invertible exact population core containing the empty test determines the minimal all-word realization and canonical probability cone. Coherent atlas transport and full packet synthesis preserve predictions. One covered reset-estimation event yields initial/core/operator/spectral bounds together; normalized filtering follows on that same event under the declared branch margins and state bounds.
assumptions: Causal finite-observation process; finite-dimensional full behavior space, finrank <= selected core dimension; selected core determinant is a unit.
A designated core test is empty, so its coordinate is the mass row.

For statistical conclusions, finite action/observation alphabet, prospectively fixed core/shifted/initial reset experiments, N>0, 0<delta<1, independent measurable bounded trials per experiment with expectations equal to actual word probabilities.
Core perturbation budget below the population rowGain, positive population rank, and perturbation below half the least-positive singular value.
Filtering additionally assumes the true and fitted recursions, uniform true-state norm bound, nonzero true branch masses, and strictly positive fitted likelihood margins.
dependency_graph: Invertible core makes test evaluation surjective; global rank upper bound makes it bijective.
Reconstructed B_s=G_s H^-1 intertwines every behavior state and reproduces every chronological word, not just selected table entries.
Core cone is the preimage/image of the actual all-test probability cone under the constructed core equivalence; invariance follows by intertwining.
Empty test identifies mass; causality gives per-action mass conservation and strictly positive mass on nonzero cone points.
Positive histories normalize to cone points; recursive inferred likelihood and update identities follow from the exact table-state equation.
A single atlas T conjugates all maps and transports mass/cone, so word likelihood and normalized state agree; complete packet synthesis uses sum P_j=id only.
Observed table fit is algebraically the coreFit of observed shifted and core matrices, with no hidden true operator used to compute it.
One simultaneous reset entry event controls all table errors; JointCertificate is derived directly from that event with one unchanged delta budget.
JointCertificate bounds each fitted symbol operator and supplies actual data-selected singular-subspace certificate under explicit gaps.
Filtering_on_joint_event feeds those very fitted symbol defects into the imported normalized path recursion, with no added probability union.

obligation_matrix.obligation: The global behavior-rank bound is retained separately from a finite invertible core; no finite-table rank test silently asserts full process rank.
Every full word is quantified, and exact normalization is interpreted only on positive histories/branches.
Canonical coreCone is actually transported from the all-test cone; it is not a supplied candidate cone.
Closedness, convexity, pointedness, spanning, invariant branches, mass row and positive-history points are checked against raw definitions.
Atlas invariance changes state, operators, mass row and cone coherently.
Full packet synthesis preserves states/readouts without assigning probability meaning to signed components.
Reset experimentWord matches core/shiftedCore chronology and matrix indices; repeated words and cross-word dependence are allowed.
The new reset_joint_event proves a conjunction from one common entry event; it does not combine separate 1-delta statements into an invalid 1-delta intersection.
All norms in statistical operator bounds are actual Euclidean operator norms.
Filtering bound retains true-state and branch-margin hypotheses; initial error remains explicit, with its reset bound separately available on the joint event.

residual_limits: No discovery of a global rank bound, actual reset law, or missing action probabilities from finite data.
No global positivity cone or internally valid fitted model follows from spectral/operator closeness alone.
Packetwise probabilities still require the extra positive-packet condition.
This review checks P37 source composition and dependency contracts, not a fresh complete proof audit of every inherited P27-P35 module.
